variants.headline: Food stewardship falls short
variants.body: Food is insufficient in {colony}, and residents are going hungry. Adequate provision must be the immediate public priority. Stewardship warrants criticism.

variants.headline: Gazette questions adequacy of stewardship
variants.body: Residents of {colony} are hungry because there is not enough food. The practical measure of a remedy is adequate provision. Stewardship warrants criticism.

variants.headline: Hunger warrants an adverse assessment
variants.body: The gazette records insufficient food and hunger in {colony}. Clear information is necessary; practical provision is the essential objective. Stewardship warrants criticism.
